item.title: Athlone Student Questions Benefit of Extra Time for Students With Additional Needs
item.description: An Athlone student says an extra ten minutes is not an advantage for those with additional needs when it comes to sitting school exams. It follows confirmation that around 300,000 candidates will benefit from extra time in written exams this year. It's part of an initiative aimed at supporting candidates with additional needs. item.title: Housing Supply Pressures Remain Acute in Parts of Shannonside Region
item.description: Housing supply pressures remain acute in parts of the Shannonside region with some of the lowest levels of construction activity in the state, according to the latest GeoDirectory Residential Buildings Report. While Ireland's total residential stock rose to just over 2.2 million dwellings by the end of 2025, counties such as Longford, Leitrim and Roscommon continue to see limited new supply, despite rising demand and increasing house prices. item.title: Over 1,000 Ukrainian pupils enrolled in local schools
item.description: New figures released have shown that over one thousand Ukrainian pupils are enrolled in schools in the Shannonside region. The findings come following a parliamentary question by Clare TD, Cathal Crowe to Minister for Education Hildegarde Naughton on the floor of the Dáil. As of the 22nd of January, county Longford is home to the third lowest number of primary school students nationally with 131. 248 Ukrainian pupils are enrolled in Roscommon primary schools, while in Leitrim, the figure is 261.
